market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$102; needs settle >=$120 by end-June (+18%). Brent already touched $120 in late Feb on Hormuz strike but has retreated; getting a daily settle to $120 requires a fresh shock or escalation.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Probability of renewed Hormuz disruption versus de-escalation.
